title: Hasta que se demuestre lo contrario: límites temporales
goal: Express temporal boundaries, deadlines, and terminal conditions using 'hasta que' with indicative and subjunctive modes.
grammar: Límites temporales y condiciones terminales: hasta que y hasta no

sections.title: Unit 7: Temporal Subordination — Lesson 2
body: Welcome to lesson 2 of Unit 7 (Temporal Subordination & Future Prospections). Mastering the boundary between indicative and subjunctive in temporal clauses is a hallmark of upper-intermediate fluency.
In this lesson, we analyze hasta que se demuestre lo contrario: límites temporales, establishing precise temporal coordination across complex sentences.

items: Express temporal boundaries, deadlines, and terminal conditions using 'hasta que' with indicative and subjunctive modes.
Incorporate advanced temporal vocabulary (el término, prescribir).
